formatDescription: The CMX Index Format is an index file associated with the CMZ format. Developed by C-Motion and acquired by HAS-Motion, the format acts as an index to help facilitate the retrieval of specific trial data found in the .cmz file. It is commonly used with Visual3D, Swift, and Inspect3D software.
provenanceCompoundName: Digital Research Alliance of Canada - FRDR / Alliance de recherche numérique du Canada – DFDR
